simulation_topic: Regulatory Test Dispute — Public Context Milestones (2015)
disclaimer: Public-event context to model. All supply-chain entities and operational numbers are synthetic.

timeline.event: State food-safety laboratory in Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh draws routine market surveillance samples of Maggi Masala noodles.
timeline.operational_impact: Incident detection trigger. Sample tied to batch production code; lot linkage verification initiated.

timeline.event: State lab report alleges parameters (lead/MSG labelling interpretations) exceed standards. Nestlé India publicly disputes methodology, noting testing protocol did not adhere to product category norms.
timeline.operational_impact: Disputed test flag set. Recommended action: HOLD + ACCREDITED NABL RE-TEST rather than immediate unrecoverable destruction.

timeline.event: National & state food authorities issue recall orders. Massive reverse-logistics operation initiated to withdraw finished stock from retail shelves and distributor warehouses across India.
timeline.operational_impact: Nationwide reverse logistics activated. High-risk states (Uttar Pradesh priority) scoped immediately.

timeline.event: Hon'ble Bombay High Court sets aside the ban, observing principles of natural justice were not met and testing was not conducted in accredited labs. Re-testing of fresh samples ordered at three certified labs.
timeline.operational_impact: Validation of LOGIS 'HOLD + RE-TEST' policy over unhedged immediate inventory destruction.

timeline.event: All fresh samples cleared by certified accredited laboratories; product re-enters nationwide distribution channels.
timeline.operational_impact: Supply chain recovery phase executed with restored safety stocks.
